unit.why: The division holds short separate anecdotes told by the Rebbe of Neshchiz: R. Gershon Kitover's meeting with the Or ha-Hayyim in the Holy Land, including his question about an unworthy student, and a tale of a printer punished for omitting the Messiah's name 'Hayyim'. Between them sits a brief exegetical remark.
unit.boundary_note: the closing words 'מענין אין אדם רואה חובה לעצמו' are the heading of the next division

stories.start_quote: סיפר מרן מנשחיז שהרהצה״ק ר׳ גרשון קיטיוור
stories.summary_en: R. Gershon Kitover meets the Or ha-Hayyim in the Holy Land and tells him of his brother-in-law the Besht, whom the Or ha-Hayyim says he knows by name. Gershon then asks about an unworthy student in his yeshiva and is told 'our way is to draw the distant near'.

stories.start_quote: וסיפר מרן שמדפיס א׳ שהיה שמו אשר
stories.end_quote: אמן מאיש אחר אמן מאיש אשר
stories.summary_en: A printer named Asher omitted the words 'and his name is Hayyim' about the Messiah from his printing of the Or ha-Hayyim. He was then punished by a misprint: 'amen from a man Asher' instead of 'amen from another man'.
